Subject: Post-call recap + rotating deep-dive timebands (proposal)

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive with your engineering + security stakeholders.

Recap (30m call):
- You want a hands-on deep-dive showing Redwood Dedicated vs Hosted config for peak inference (3–5M tokens/day).
- Primary concerns: cross-region failover, per-route cost controls, and audit log retention.
- Stakeholders: Alex Chen (you), Sofia Patel (EU infra lead), and an internal procurement contact (TBD).

Ask / Next steps:
1) Schedule a 75-minute technical deep-dive (engine performance, KV cache, rollout plan).
2) Propose a rotating set of weekly timebands so we can include US/EU/APAC participants without repeated late nights for any one group.
3) Share access to your requirements doc and any AV constraints.

Rotation proposal (high level):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 19:00 CET / Wed 02:00 SGT
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 14:00 CET / Wed 05:00 PT / Thu 21:00 SGT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 10:00 SGT / Thu 19:00 PT / Thu 07:00 CET

Attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft) — includes milestone owners and proposed attendees per session.

If you can confirm which week (A/B/C) you'd prefer to start with and 2–3 available slots in that band, we'll send an invite and a targeted runbook for the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Diego Fernández
